:::{#exm-vec-outer-product}
#### Vectorizing an outer product

For $\vecf{u} = (1, 2, 3)$ and $\vecf{v} = (4, 5)$,
[the example of an outer product](#exm-outer-product) found the [outer product](#def-outer-product)
$\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}$, whose [column](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-column)s are $(4, 8, 12)$ and $(5, 10, 15)$.
Its [vectorization](#def-vectorization) and the [Kronecker product](#def-kronecker-product) $\vecf{v} \otimes \vecf{u}$ agree:

$$
\ba
\vctf{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}}
&= \begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ 8 \\ 12 \\ 5 \\ 10 \\ 15 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(stack the columns)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 4 \cd \vecf{u} \\ 5 \cd \vecf{u} \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(each column is a multiple of } \vecf{u} \text{)}
\\
&= \vecf{v} \otimes \vecf{u}
&& \text{(definition of the Kronecker product)}
\ea
$$

as @thm-vec-outer-product says.
